major_cooldowns.name: Summon Darkglare
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pool Soul Shards and get Agony plus Corruption or Wither ticking, then summon it before you start chaining Unstable Affliction so its 20% dot amp covers their whole duration.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 205180 is the cast id and also shows as the player's Darkglare window aura in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Dark Harvest
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown whenever its Soul Shards will not overcap you, and sync one into every Darkglare window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table base_cd_s is 60; the guide states Cull the Weak reduces it to roughly 40 seconds, so 40 is used here. 1257065 shares the name and was not observed as a cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Malevolence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pair it with every Summon Darkglare and send the off minute cast as soon as it is up, since it adds 6 stacks to each active Wither.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Hellcaller capstone; 442726 is castable per its tooltip, 430014 shares the name and looks like the talent or buff. Neither was observed in the sampled parses, which were all Soul Harvester.

rule.description: Open with Agony, then Darkglare, then Unstable Affliction
rule.action: Get Agony ticking, summon Darkglare, then chain Unstable Affliction under it.

rule.description: Keep Agony up on the boss
rule.action: Reapply it as it enters its pandemic window, and refresh on the move rather than casting nothing.

rule.description: Keep Haunt up on your priority target
rule.action: Recast it the moment it comes off cooldown, on your priority target in AoE.

rule.description: Refresh Agony late, do not clip it
rule.action: Hold the refresh until it is inside its 4.5 second pandemic window.

rule.description: Malefic Grasp is your filler inside Darkglare
rule.action: Channel Malefic Grasp while Darkglare is out and save Drain Soul or Shadow Bolt for the rest of the fight.

rule.description: Press Dark Harvest below the shard cap
rule.action: Dump a shard or two into Unstable Affliction first so the 3 shards it grants are not wasted.
Fire Unstable Affliction the moment it procs, or Seed of Corruption when you are in AoE.

rule.description: Seed of Corruption on multiple targets
rule.action: Switch to Seed of Corruption from 2 targets as Soul Harvester and 3 as Hellcaller, keeping Agony on a handful of them.

rule.description: Pair Dark Harvest with Summon Darkglare
rule.action: Send Dark Harvest inside the same window so its damage and shards land under the dot amp.
